faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our subscriptions

items.question: How does the subscription work?
items.answer: You choose a plan (Pro or Business) with monthly or annual billing. The subscription is automatically renewed each period. You can cancel at any time from your company dashboard, with no fees.

items.question: Can I change plans at any time?
items.answer: Yes, you can switch plans at any time. If you upgrade, you only pay the prorated difference for the remaining days. If you downgrade, the change takes effect at the next billing cycle.

items.question: Are there any hidden fees or commitments?
items.answer: No hidden fees. The displayed prices are final, all taxes included. There are no long-term commitments: you can cancel anytime. The annual subscription offers a 20% discount compared to the monthly rate, but you are free to cancel before the end of the annual period (cancellation will take effect at the end of the current year).

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: Certainly. Cancellation is done in one click from your company dashboard, under 'Subscription'. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the paid period. No refunds are given for unused periods, except as required by law.

items.question: Do my job listings stay online after my subscription ends?
items.answer: Yes, your active listings remain published until their normal expiration date. You simply won't be able to post new ones if you've reached your new plan's limit (or the free limit).

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept major international credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via Stripe, a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment processor. We never store your card details on our servers.

items.question: How is my billing data managed?
items.answer: Your billing data (address, payment history) is stored securely and never shared with third parties. You can view and download your invoices from your company dashboard.

items.question: Do you offer solutions for large groups or specific needs?
items.answer: Yes, we offer custom Enterprise plans. Contact our sales team via the Contact page to discuss your requirements: unlimited users, advanced API integration, dedicated support, SLA, training, etc.

items.question: Can I use the free plan indefinitely?
items.answer: The free plan allows you to test the platform with 1 active job. It has no time limit. You can upgrade to a paid plan whenever you need more features.

items.question: What happens if I exceed my job limit?
items.answer: If you reach your plan's limit, you won't be able to publish new jobs. You can either archive older jobs or upgrade to the next plan to increase your quota.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for new subscribers. If you're not satisfied, contact us for a full refund.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quickly find answers to your questions about Actoos Jobs.
faq.noResultsHint: Try different keywords or browse the categories.

questions.q: What is Actoos Jobs?
questions.a: Actoos Jobs is the leading recruitment platform in Mali and West Africa. We connect qualified candidates with local and international companies. You can search for jobs, apply easily, and track your applications. Recruiters can post jobs, manage applications, and schedule interviews – all for free with a premium subscription option.

questions.q: Is registration free?
questions.a: Yes, registration and basic usage are completely free for candidates. Companies can also create a free account and post a limited number of jobs. Paid plans are available for advanced features (more jobs, increased visibility, etc.).

questions.q: How do I create an account?
questions.a: Click on 'Sign up' at the top right of the site. You can choose a Candidate or Company account. Fill out the form with your email and password, or sign in quickly with Google. Your account will be created instantly.

questions.q: How do I apply for a job?
questions.a: Browse jobs from the 'Jobs' page. Click on a job to see details, then on 'Apply'. If you haven't completed your profile yet, we will invite you to do so to optimize your chances. Once your application is sent, the company is immediately notified.

questions.q: What is the matching score?
questions.a: It's an estimate of how well your profile matches a job. The higher the score, the more your skills, experience, and salary expectations align with what the employer is looking for. It helps you identify the most promising opportunities.

questions.q: Can I save jobs for later?
questions.a: Absolutely. Click on the heart icon at the top right of the job to add it to your favorites. Find them in your dashboard under 'Saved jobs'.

questions.q: How do job alerts work?
questions.a: From your dashboard, go to 'Job alerts'. Define your criteria (keywords, city, category, minimum salary, frequency). You'll receive an email as soon as a matching job is published.

questions.q: What should I do if I encounter a technical issue?
questions.a: You can contact us via the contact form (Contact page) or report inappropriate content directly from the job listing. Our team acts quickly.

questions.q: How do I create a company profile?
questions.a: After creating a 'Company' account, go to your dashboard and click 'Create my company'. Fill in the required information (name, sector, description, logo, etc.). Your company will be submitted for validation by our team. Once approved, you can post jobs.

questions.q: Why is my company pending validation?
questions.a: To ensure the quality and reliability of job listings, we manually verify each new company. This usually takes less than 24 hours. You will be notified by email once validated. In the meantime, you can prepare job drafts.

questions.q: How many jobs can I post?
questions.a: With the free plan, you can post 1 active job. The Pro and Business plans allow you to post more jobs simultaneously. You can always save unlimited drafts. See the 'Pricing' page for more details.

questions.q: How do I manage received applications?
questions.a: In your dashboard, go to 'Applications'. You will see all applications sorted by job. You can change the status (viewed, shortlisted, interview, accepted, rejected). The candidate will be notified automatically by email.

questions.q: Can I schedule a video interview directly from the platform?
questions.a: Yes, on the application detail page, you can generate a Jitsi video conference link with one click and email it to the candidate. You can also use our AI assistant to prepare personalized interview questions.

questions.q: How do I cancel my paid subscription?
questions.a: Go to your dashboard, in the subscription section, click 'Cancel'. You can optionally provide a reason. Your subscription will immediately be downgraded to the free plan. You will no longer be billed.

questions.q: What payment methods are accepted?
questions.a: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard) through our partner Stripe. All payments are secure and in CFA francs (XOF).

questions.q: Can I change my plan at any time?
questions.a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade. The difference will be calculated on a prorated basis. Annual plans offer a 20% discount.

questions.q: What happens after cancellation?
questions.a: Your account remains active and your published jobs stay online until they expire. You are switched back to the free plan and lose access to premium features (additional jobs, boosts, etc.).

questions.q: Is my personal data protected?
questions.a: Yes. We enforce a strict privacy policy. Your information is never shared without your consent. See our 'Privacy' page for more details.

questions.q: How do I report a fraudulent offer or abuse?
questions.a: On every job listing and company page, you will find a 'Report' button. Select the reason and describe the issue. Our moderation team reviews every report as quickly as possible.

questions.q: Can I delete my account?
questions.a: Yes, contact us via the contact form stating your request. We will proceed with the deletion of your account and all associated data in accordance with regulations.

whatIsCookie.title: 1. What is a cookie?
whatIsCookie.content: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device (computer, phone, tablet) when you visit a website. Cookies allow the site to recognize your device and remember certain information about your preferences or past actions.

subsections.title: Essential cookies
subsections.content: Necessary for the operation of the Platform. They allow you to use basic features such as secure login and navigation between pages.

subsections.title: Preference cookies
subsections.content: Allow us to remember your preferences (language, region, display settings) to personalize your experience.

subsections.title: Analytics cookies
subsections.content: Help us understand how visitors interact with our site by collecting anonymous information about pages visited and time spent.

subsections.title: Marketing cookies
subsections.content: Used to track visitors across websites and display relevant and interesting advertisements to the user.

thirdParty.title: 3. Third-party cookies

- Through your browser settings
- Using our cookie consent banner
- By installing cookie blocking extensions

Note: Disabling certain cookies may affect your experience on the Platform.

- Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies
- Firefox: Options > Privacy & security > Cookies
- Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Cookies
- Edge: Settings > Privacy > Cookies

items.title: How to write a standout CV in 2026
items.excerpt: Discover the best practices for creating a modern and effective CV that will catch recruiters' attention.
items.content:
Introduction

A well-written CV is your passport to landing an interview. Here are the golden rules for 2026.

1. Customize your CV for each job

Adapt the title, skills and experience according to the job posting.

2. Pay attention to the layout

Use a clean layout, a readable font and a PDF format.

3. Highlight your achievements

Quantify your results: "Increased revenue by 20%".

Apply these tips and you'll increase your chances of being noticed.
items.author: Actoos Team

items.title: 10 mistakes to avoid in job interviews
items.excerpt: Prepare yourself for interviews by avoiding these common mistakes that most candidates make.
items.content:
Fatal interview mistakes

Here are the pitfalls to avoid to make a good impression.

1. Arriving late

Allow a 15-minute margin.

2. Not researching the company

Show that you know their business and values.

3. Only talking about yourself

Ask relevant questions about the position.

Avoiding these mistakes will help you succeed in your interview.
items.author: Actoos Team

items.title: Salary negotiation: a complete guide
items.excerpt: Learn how to negotiate your salary with confidence and get the compensation you deserve.
items.content:
Why negotiate?

Salary negotiation is a crucial step. Here's how to go about it.

1. Know your market value

Use tools like Glassdoor or PayScale.

2. Wait for the right moment

Bring up the topic after proving your value.

3. Propose a range

Give a realistic range and justify it.

With these tips, you'll maximize your compensation.
items.author: Actoos Team

items.title: Career change: where to start?

1. Take stock of your situation

A successful career change requires time and method.
